changelog_text:
Updated for KSA Build v2026.11.25.5949. Requires Windows and StarMap 0.5.4 or later.

The editor smoke test passed in Borea. Includes the battery and tank bay compatibility patches.

listing.name: NodeLock
listing.abstract: Lock attachment nodes while placing parts, with battery and tank bay compatibility included.
listing.description: Keep a part snapped to the attachment node you choose while rotating it into place. Hover over a node and tap Tab to lock it, rotate with WASD/QE, then click to attach. Tap Tab again to unlock. Includes bay compatibility for radial batteries and spherical tanks.
